verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review agent automatically reviews every new pull request in selected repos or across the whole org. It runs with no setup, is offered as "Unlimited AI Reviews," and can be tuned with custom rules, so it can review agent-authored PRs at machine volume. GT MCP also splits large AI-generated changes into smaller reviewable stacked PRs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of handling specifically for agent-authored PRs, evidence of verification depth such as catch-rate data, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the reviewer reliably gates AI-generated code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer holds the line on AI-generated PRs — it verifies agent-authored code at a volume no human team could review

citations.quote: AI reviews analyze every pull request in your repositories, identifying potential issues and suggesting fixes instantly - no manual configuration required.
Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories
GT MCP allows AI agents to automatically create stacked PRs, breaking down large AI-generated changes into smaller, reviewable stacked pull requests.
Custom rules allow you to define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing your code.
